fields.title: Webhook or polling
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: Choose the mechanism and state what you will supplement it with.
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: 1 — webhook plus reconciliation every 5 minutes, latency is critical, loss is unacceptable. 2 — scheduled polling, they don't have webhooks, latency is tolerable. 3 — webhook plus reconciliation every 15 minutes for active orders. 4 — polling once a day, events are rare. Anywhere you use a webhook: signature verification is mandatory and reconciliation is mandatory, because our downtime turns into lost events.
